newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Regal Hotels to launch HK$4.6 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: Regal Hotels to launch HK$4.6 bln loan.

text.p: Hong Kong's Regal Hotels International Holdings Ltd will launch a HK$4.6 billion syndicated loan next month, one of the arrangers said on Thursday.
The facility will be launched through a wholly-owned subsidiary and backed by Regal Hotels International Holdings Ltd, she said.
The seven-year facility has a put option in year five.
General syndication will follow the formation of an underwriting group, she said.

Regal has mandated HSBC Investment Bank Asia, Bank of China and Hang Seng Finance to lead the deal, and proceeds will be used for general working capital, chairman Lo Yuk-sui said at the company's annual meeting this week.
